registry.name: Arcanum: Of Steamworks & Magick Obscura Demo
registry.license: Sierra/Troika demo; redistribution not granted, so keep this a local ignored candidate fixture
registry.notes: The archive.org original is a RAR; the browser's zip mount cannot open RAR, so it was repacked locally as ArcanumDemo.zip (same tree, plus macOS __MACOSX forks) and mounted as zip:arcanumdemo. That mount crashed at launch with 'ChunkCache: fill did not satisfy read': a readRange wider than the cache's 64x256KB LRU bound evicted its own leading chunks, fixed in lib/byte-provider.js.

note: Existing installed original fixture reused, all installed paths and hashes in assets.json. No media download, install or cold archive restore performed.
